blocking.issue: .vue is not in P-CODE, so Vue single-file components are P-OTHER. Vue work whose message names the target is classed MENTION-ONLY, or UNCLASSIFIABLE when the lines themselves hit. It is never EXECUTION-TRACE, which can give a false NOT-EVIDENCED-IN-CAPTURE or a wrong earliest trace.

Generic P-DOC segment words (plans, reports, notes, decisions, registers, evidence) and basenames (plan.*, register.*, decision.*, acceptance.*) match anywhere in the tree and take precedence over TEST and CODE. Ordinary Laravel code becomes DOC, for example app/Models/Plan.php, resources/views/auth/register.blade.php, resources/js/Pages/Auth/Register.vue, app/Http/Controllers/Reports/*.php and tests/Feature/Plans/*Test.php.

.claude/, engineering/ and developer_guide/ are not P-DOC; only their .md files count as documentation, through the extension. Scripts or code there (for example .claude/hooks/*.sh|py|js, engineering/tools/*.py, developer_guide/examples/*.php) are P-CODE and can produce an EXECUTION-TRACE from governance or agent tooling. P-CODE and P-TEST are defined by extension only, not by the application roots (app/, routes/, database/, resources/, config/, tests/).

nonblocking.issue: The script does not check that OUT lies outside the work tree and .git. If OUT were under .git/refs, files would be created there before for-each-ref (line 65) runs, corrupting the captured ref set.
Local .git/config, including include.path, is still read. GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES are not unset. diff.algorithm and i18n.logOutputEncoding are not pinned.

For a path containing a space, git appends a TAB to the +++ header. p (line 96) then has a trailing tab: pclass returns OTHER and 12_line_hits.tsv gains an extra column, which shifts the fields classify reads. Paths with quote or control characters stay C-quoted.
T2 has no right boundary: wp4c1-2... matches, while the T1 equivalent WP-4C-1-2 is excluded.
T1 accepts the range or list forms WP-4C-1..3, WP-4C-1/2 and WP-4C-1,2.
EXECUTION-TRACE does not separate adding from removing. Deletion-only commits, revert commits, and messages that mainly cite a sibling item but also name WP-4C-1 all count.

Some stages are not checked for errors: lines 68, 74, 89, 104-106 and 138-158, and the final sort in the pipelines at lines 78, 85 and 92. A silent failure there could let absence be asserted on incomplete data.
Shallow and partial clones, and grafts, are not detected or recorded in the coverage statement.
refs/stash, if present, is walked. A stash index commit copies the HEAD subject and could become EXECUTION-TRACE with the stash's date.
Ref names and paths are stored verbatim and may contain personal handles. 00_stderr.log may contain absolute paths.
js() does not escape control characters or non-UTF-8 bytes, and a ';' inside a path corrupts the matched_paths array.
In PROTOCOL-A, the C5 example 'P-DOC/P-OTHER mix' only holds when there is a path or line hit. A message-only hit with that mix is C4. The wording should be clarified.
The hyphen list leaves out U+2043, U+058A, U+1806 and U+2E3A/B. Acceptable because the list is fixed in advance, but the omission should be stated.
Ref names are not searched. This is consistent with the four places TASK specifies.
